system.description:
A voice of the underclass — satirists, protest singers, broadsheet writers. Art as disruption.

  • Hostile Crowd: Sway Crowd works even against actively hostile crowds if the Bard can perform for at least 1 round uninterrupted. When a creature fails its save against your Discord, one ally who can hear you has Advantage on their next attack roll against it.
  • Underground Voice: Advantage on Legend Lore checks involving Mournas's criminal history, underground movements, or the Rebellion.
